reply_text:
I replied to Linnea in her DM, with one of her two answers confirmed.

1. Main contact: Lysander Vesfield, Transportation Manager at Sablehithe Paper Mill, leads the Indigo rollout on their side. This comes from Moss's Canyon cheat sheet, updated 9/28. Sablehithe Paper Mill is a Canyon team account owned by Sebastien Keldale, not a Sierra one.

2. Renewal date: I couldn't confirm one from anything Linnea can see. The Canyon digests and cheat sheet don't give it, and none of the account files for Sablehithe Paper Mill are open to her. The only mention is her own post in #sierra-team on May 1 ("as I remember it... January 20, 2027"), which she said at the time was from memory and not checked. I suggested she confirm the date with Sebastien before it goes in the file.

I only used public files, #sierra-team (which she's in) and her DM with me. No approvals were needed.
